<p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman">Indicate by check mark whether the registrant is an emerging growth company as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act of 1933 (&#167;230.405 of this chapter) or Rule 12b-2 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (&#167; 240.12b-2 of this chapter).</span></p>

<p style="text-align: right"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman">Emerging growth company&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman"><span id="xdx_903_edei--EntityEmergingGrowthCompany_c20210729__20210730_zKzkdlf9Fqbe"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2021-07-29to2021-07-30" format="ixt:booleanfalse" name="dei:EntityEmergingGrowthCompany">&#9744;</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<hr style="border-width: 0; width: 100%; color: Gray; background-color: Gray; height: 2px" />



<div style="page-break-before: always"></div>



<p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman; font-weight: bold">Item 3.03 Material Modification to Rights of Security Holders.</span></p>

<p style="text-indent: 15pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman">On July 30, 2021, General Electric Company (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) filed a Certificate of Amendment to its Certificate of Incorporation (the &#8220;Certificate of Amendment&#8221;) in order to effect a one-for-eight reverse stock split of the Company&#8217;s common stock, together with a corresponding proportionate reduction in the shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock authorized under the Certificate of Incorporation, as amended, from 13,200,000,000 shares to 1,650,000,000 shares, and a reduction of the par value per share of common stock from $0.06 to $0.01 (collectively, the &#8220;Reverse Stock Split&#8221;).</span></p>

<p style="text-indent: 15pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman">The Certificate of Amendment became effective upon acceptance for filing on July 30, 2021. The foregoing summary of the Certificate of Amendment is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Certificate of Amendment, which is attached hereto as Exhibit 3.1 and incorporated herein by reference.</span></p>

<p style="text-indent: 15pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman">On August 2, 2021, GE common stock will begin trading, on a split-adjusted basis, (i) on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol &#8220;GE&#8221;, with a new CUSIP number (369604 301), and (ii) on the London Stock Exchange under the symbol &#8220;GEC&#8221;, Euronext Paris under the symbol &#8220;GNE&#8221;, the SIX Swiss Exchange under the symbol &#8220;GE&#8221; and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under the symbol &#8220;GEC&#8221;, each with a new ISIN (US3696043013).</span></p>

<p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman; font-weight: bold">Item 8.01 Other Events.</span></p>

<p style="text-indent: 15pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman">In connection with the Reverse Stock Split, the number of shares registered on applicable registration statements filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission have been proportionately reduced. Additionally, as a result of the Reverse Stock Split, the Company made anti-dilution adjustments to the 2007 Long-Term Incentive Plan, as amended and restated (the &#8220;Plan&#8221;), and to the outstanding awards issued under the Plan in accordance with the terms of the Plan.</span></p>

<p style="text-indent: 15pt; text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman">On July 30, 2021, the Company issued a press release announcing the effectiveness of the Reverse Stock Split. A copy of the press release is filed as Exhibit 99.1 to this report and is incorporated herein by reference.</span></p>

<p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman; font-weight: bold">Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.</span></p>

<TYPE>EX-3.1

<FILENAME>ge3936671-ex31.htm
<DESCRIPTION>CERTIFICATE OF AMENDMENT TO THE CERTIFICATE OF INCORPORATION
<TEXT>

<HTML>
<HEAD>
   <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>

<BODY bgcolor="#ffffff">



<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>CERTIFICATE OF AMENDMENT</FONT></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>OF</FONT></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>THE CERTIFICATE OF INCORPORATION</FONT></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>OF</FONT></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>GENERAL ELECTRIC COMPANY </FONT></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>UNDER SECTION 805 </FONT></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>OF</FONT></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>THE BUSINESS CORPORATION LAW OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK</FONT></B></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>FIRST</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>: The name of the Corporation is General Electric Company.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>SECOND: </FONT></B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>The Corporation was incorporated by special act of the New York Legislature, Chapter 323, Laws of 1892, effective April 15, 1892.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>THIRD: </FONT></B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>The subject of this amendment by General Electric Company is to effect a combination of its Common Stock, $0.06 par value (the &#8220;Common Stock&#8221;) which is to be effected by means of a one-share-for-eight-shares combination of its Common Stock issued and outstanding or held in treasury, by reducing in the same proportion its authorized Common Stock from 13,200,000,000 authorized shares of Common Stock to 1,650,000,000 authorized shares of Common Stock, and by reducing the par value from $0.06 to $0.01. There is no impact on the number of the 50,000,000 authorized shares of preferred stock of the par value of $1.00 each.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>FOURTH: </FONT></B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>In order to give effect to the foregoing combination of the Common Stock, as of the time that this Certificate of Amendment to the Certificate of Incorporation becomes effective pursuant to the New York Business Corporation Law, clause A. of Section 3 of the Certificate of Incorporation is hereby replaced in its entirety with the following:</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>&#8220;The aggregate number of shares which the corporation is authorized to issue is 1,700,000,000 shares, consisting of:</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>1. 1,650,000,000 shares of common stock having a par value of $0.01 per share; and</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>2. 50,000,000 shares of preferred stock having a par value of $1 per share.&#8221;</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Every eight shares of Common Stock issued and outstanding or held by the Corporation in treasury immediately prior to the time that this Certificate of Amendment of the Certificate of Incorporation becomes effective pursuant to the New York Business Corporation Law shall be, effective as of the effectiveness of this Certificate of Amendment, automatically and without any action on the part of the Corporation or the respective holders thereof, combined and changed into one issued, fully paid and nonassessable share of Common Stock, subject to the treatment of fractional share interests described below. No fractional shares will be issued in connection with the combination of shares of Common Stock. In lieu of any fractional share which a shareholder would otherwise be entitled to receive as a result of the combination of shares of Common Stock, such shareholder will be entitled to receive a cash amount (without interest) equal to, as the Corporation shall determine, either (i) each such shareholder&#8217;s proportionate interest in the proceeds, net of selling costs not paid and satisfied by the Corporation, from the aggregation and sale of the fractional shares by the transfer agent of the Corporation or (ii) the closing price of our Common Stock as reported on the New York Stock Exchange on the trading day immediately preceding the date that this Certificate of Amendment of the Certificate of Incorporation becomes effective, as adjusted by the ratio of one share of Common Stock for every eight shares of Common Stock, multiplied by the applicable fraction of a share.</FONT></P>

<HR align=center SIZE=2 width="100%" noShade>



<DIV style="PAGE-BREAK-BEFORE: always"></DIV>





<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>FIFTH: </FONT></B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Immediately prior to the effectiveness of this Certificate of Amendment, the Corporation had issued approximately 11,693,841,042 shares of Common Stock, $0.06 par value, including approximately 2,912,537,933 treasury shares. Immediately prior to effectiveness of this Certificate of Amendment, the number of unissued shares of Common Stock, $0.06 par value, was approximately 1,506,158,958.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>At the effectiveness of this Certificate of Amendment, and disregarding the elimination of fractional shares, there will be approximately 1,461,730,130 issued shares of Common Stock, $0.01 par value, including approximately 364,067,241 treasury shares. At the effectiveness of this Certificate of Amendment, subject to the elimination of fractional shares, there will be approximately 188,269,870 unissued shares of Common Stock, $0.01 par value.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>SIXTH: </FONT></B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>As a result of the combination of shares of Common Stock and reduction in par value, the stated capital of the Corporation will be reduced in proportion to the ratio of one share of Common Stock for every eight shares of Common Stock, and the Corporation&#8217;s additional paid-in capital will be credited with the amount by which stated capital is reduced. The stated capital of the Corporation pursuant to the New York Business Corporation Law immediately prior to the effectiveness of this Certificate of Amendment is approximately $707,570,338 and the stated capital of the Corporation pursuant to the New York Business Corporation Law at the effectiveness of this Certificate of Amendment will be approximately $20,557,176.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>SEVENTH</FONT></B><FONT size=2 face=Arial>: The amendment of the Certificate of Incorporation as set forth herein was authorized by the affirmative vote of the holders of a majority of all outstanding shares of the Corporation entitled to vote thereon, at a meeting of the shareholders duly called, noticed and held on May 4, 2021, pursuant to authorization by the Board of Directors of the Corporation.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>[Signature Page Follows]</FONT></P>

<HR align=center SIZE=2 width="100%" noShade>



<DIV style="PAGE-BREAK-BEFORE: always"></DIV>



<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Corporation has caused this Certificate of Amendment of the Certificate of Incorporation to be executed by a duly authorized person as of the 30th day of July, 2021.</FONT></P>

<TYPE>EX-99.1
<SEQUENCE>3
<FILENAME>ge3936671-ex911.htm
<DESCRIPTION>PRESS RELEASE, DATED JULY 30, 2021
<TEXT>

<HTML>
<HEAD>
   <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>

<BODY bgcolor="#ffffff">



<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>GE COMPLETES ONE-FOR-EIGHT REVERSE STOCK SPLIT</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>BOSTON &#8212; July 30, 2021 &#8212; GE (NYSE:GE) announced today that it has completed the previously announced reverse stock split of GE common stock at a ratio of 1-for-8, with a proportionate reduction in the authorized shares of its common stock, and reduction in the par value of common stock to $0.01 per share.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>The reverse stock split, authorized share reduction and par value reduction were approved by GE shareholders at the annual meeting of shareholders on May 4, 2021. GE filed an amendment to its certificate of incorporation, which was accepted for filing by the New York Department of State on July 30, 2021.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>GE common stock will begin trading on a split-adjusted basis when the New York Stock Exchange opens on August 2, 2021 and will continue trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol &#8220;GE&#8221;, with a new CUSIP number (369604 301), and on the London Stock Exchange under the symbol &#8220;GEC&#8221;, Euronext Paris under the symbol &#8220;GNE&#8221;, the SIX Swiss Exchange under the symbol &#8220;GE&#8221; and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under the symbol &#8220;GEC&#8221;, each with a new ISIN number (US3696043013).</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>As a result of the reverse stock split, every eight shares of GE common stock issued and outstanding or held as treasury shares were automatically combined into one share of GE common stock. This reduced the number of outstanding shares of GE common stock from approximately 8.8 billion to approximately 1.1 billion. Outstanding GE equity-based awards and shares or share units under GE benefit plans were proportionately adjusted.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>No fractional shares were issued in connection with the reverse stock split. Shareholders that would hold a fractional share as a result of the reverse stock split will receive a cash payment in lieu of such fractional shares.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>The company&#8217;s transfer agent, Equiniti Trust Company (&#8220;EQ&#8221;), is acting as exchange agent for the reverse stock split. GE shareholders holding their shares of common stock in book entry form or in &#8220;street name&#8221; through a bank, broker or other nominee and holders of shares held in certificated form with an aggregate value of $2,000 or less as part or all of an account holding do not need to take any action in connection with the reverse stock split. GE shareholders holding their shares of common stock in certificated form with an aggregate value of more than $2,000 as part or all of an account holding will receive a letter of transmittal from EQ shortly following the effective date. EQ can be contacted toll free at 1-800-786-2543, or directly at 1-651-450-4064.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Additional information concerning the reverse stock split can be found in GE&#8217;s definitive proxy statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;) on March 22, 2021, as well as on GE&#8217;s Investor Relations website, https://www.ge.com/investor-relations.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>About GE</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>GE (NYSE:GE) rises to the challenge of building a world that works. For more than 125 years, GE has invented the future of industry, and today the company&#8217;s dedicated team, leading technology, and global reach and capabilities help the world work more efficiently, reliably, and safely. GE&#8217;s people are diverse and dedicated, operating with the highest level of integrity and focus to fulfill GE&#8217;s mission and deliver for its customers. www.ge.com</FONT></P>

<HR align=center SIZE=2 width="100%" noShade>



<DIV style="PAGE-BREAK-BEFORE: always"></DIV>



<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>For media inquiries, please contact:</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Tara DiJulio <BR>GE<BR></FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>+1 202 213 6855 <BR>Tara.Dijulio@ge.com</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left"><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Steve Winoker<BR></FONT><FONT size=2 face=Arial>Vice President, Investor Relations <BR>617.443.3400 <BR>swinoker@ge.com</FONT></P>

var Show={};Show.LastAR=null,Show.showAR=function(a,r,w){if(Show.LastAR)Show.hideAR();var e=a;while(e&&e.nodeName!='TABLE')e=e.nextSibling;if(!e||e.nodeName!='TABLE'){var ref=((window)?w.document:document).getElementById(r);if(ref){e=ref.cloneNode(!0);
e.removeAttribute('id');a.parentNode.appendChild(e)}}
if(e)e.style.display='block';Show.LastAR=e};Show.hideAR=function(){Show.LastAR.style.display='none'};Show.toggleNext=function(a){var e=a;while(e.nodeName!='DIV')e=e.nextSibling;if(!e.style){}else if(!e.style.display){}else{var d,p_;if(e.style.display=='none'){d='block';p='-'}else{d='none';p='+'}
e.style.display=d;if(a.textContent){a.textContent=p+a.textContent.substring(1)}else{a.innerText=p+a.innerText.substring(1)}}}
